Male figure: original BodyKun body with the reviewed replacement face.

Head source: homework2 male Head
Author: Liang0110
License of the supplied head: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Supplied file: homework2_male_head.glb

Modifications: fitted face and neck to the existing BodyKun body; adjusted facial
proportions, nose, lips, ears and silhouette; softened cheek, mouth and chin folds.
Restored the original BodyKun torso and lower neck parts, undoing the trapezius
lowering. A short neck connector joins the unchanged reviewed face/upper neck.
The original torso and limb geometry, normals and skin weights are preserved.
The 62 web rig bones and their inverse bind matrices are unchanged.
This attribution describes the head component, not a new license for the BodyKun body.
Original supplied source files are preserved outside the repository. The web GLB
is included at the project owner's request (2026-10-27).
